finding.description: Each redirect URL is canonicalized, but the retained redirect chain is not required to terminate at the retained final_url. An empty redirect chain can also retain a final_url different from the requested URL.
finding.scientific_risk: The attempt record may not reconstruct which endpoint supplied the authoritative bytes, weakening source provenance before catalogue metadata access.

required_correction.redirected_attempt: canonical final_url must equal the last canonical redirect_chain URL
required_correction.non_redirected_attempt: canonical final_url must equal the canonical requested URL
regression_tests: reject a nonempty redirect chain whose last URL differs from final_url
reject an empty redirect chain whose final_url differs from requested_url

authorization: Do not execute the frozen transport or access UCR catalogue metadata until the correction and both regression tests are committed and both required workflows pass on that exact head.
claim_boundary: Transport-provenance review evidence only; not external validation, independent replication, novelty proof, or a breakthrough.
